dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual linear narrowing from the widest mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical outward curvature on the left lateral margin relative to the central longitudinal axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity light-grey shading across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse grey pigmentation localized on the cephalic region and along the mid-dorsal ridge.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary white skin and localized grey-toned patches.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct dark transverse linear mark on the dorsal surface of the cephalic region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark transverse mark on the upper head region; faint localized dark pixel cluster on the lower peduncle.
